pr_title: usb: device_next: respect bMaxPacketSize0 in control transfers
pr_body:
Only the device operating at high speed has bMaxPacketSize0 set to 64
bytes, the device operating at other speeds may have a different value.
For full speed, use the value from the full speed descriptor.

Fixes: #79194
pr_comments: Verified on Smartbond to work as advertised

issue_context.title: Function usbd_ep_ctrl_set_zlp() works incorrect for devices with MPS != 64
issue_context.body:
<!--
**Notes**
Github Discussions (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/discussions)
are available to first verify that the issue is a genuine Zephyr bug and not a
consequence of Zephyr services misuse.

This issue list is only for bugs in the main Zephyr code base
(https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/). If the bug is for a project
fork (such as NCS) specific feature, please open an issue in the fork project
instead.
-->

**Describe the bug**
For devices that have *EP0 MPS < 64* function `usbd_ep_ctrl_set_zlp()` will not
set zlp bit when all data was already sent and ZLP is required by host.

```c
static void usbd_ep_ctrl_set_zlp(struct usbd_context *const uds_ctx,
				 struct net_buf *const buf)
   ...
	if (setup->wLength > min_len && !(min_len % USB_CONTROL_EP_MPS)) { // !! Offending line
```
Definition of USB_CONTROL_EP_MPS is hardcoded this way
```c
#define USB_CONTROL_EP_MPS		64U
```

This was discovered during implementation #79184 of UDC driver for Smartbond #74662 .

Sample `samples/subsys/usb/mass` that triggers error since it generates 32 bytes long
descriptor.

It can also be triggered if other descriptors (like string descriptors) have length `8 * n`.

I think it can be also tested on other boards if MPS is artificially change to be 8 (this scenario was
tested on previous USB stack on STM32 devices that are capable to be configured
with EP0 MPS < 64.

-->

**To Reproduce**
<!--
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. mkdir build; cd build
2. cmake -DBOARD=board\_xyz
3. make
4. See error
-->

```sh
west build -b da1469x_dk_pro samples/subsys/usb/mass -DEXTRA_DTC_OVERLAY_FILE="ramdisk.overlay" -DCONFIG_APP_MSC_STORAGE_RAM=y -DCONF_FILE="usbd_next_prj.conf"
```

**Impact**
<!--
What impact does this issue have on your progress (e.g., annoyance, showstopper)
-->

Devices with EP0 MPS < 64 will not work (This applies to Smartbond and some other device)

**Environment:**

 - OS: any
 - Commit SHA or Version used: 2815b6d710ad9c7ba25725ae34c402fc9153c427

review_comments: Initializing to 0 leads to taking remainder from division by zero later on. This would only trigger in the asserts-disabled case. Not sure if it would be better to just default to `USB_CONTROL_EP_MPS` instead of `0` here.
